summary.text: Tyler Smith, a Republican, represents Georgia House District 18 and was sworn in on January 11, 2021.

paragraphs.text: He earned a B.A. in political science from The Citadel and a J.D. from John Marshall Law School.
He has worked as an associate attorney, a law clerk and a legislative aide, and the General Assembly's member page lists his occupation as attorney and farmer and his residence as Bremen.
